# Coding Style Standard

Fictional standard, used only as a real on-disk target for `tests/export.test.ts`'s
`crossPackageLinks: 'address'` case (`postProcessRendered` reads the target file's own
frontmatter plus its package's `knowledge.toml` off disk to recover its address).
